method: Rows of hdb-property-information.csv with bldg_contract_town in ['BM', 'BT', 'CL', 'QT'] and residential == 'Y', unchanged, plus OneMap geocode columns. Query '<blk_no> <street>'; a result matches when BLK_NO equals blk_no and ROAD_NAME equals street after expanding HDB abbreviations (ABBREV table in the script). exact: all matches within 1 m; ambiguous: matches more than 1 m apart, first used; unmatched: no match. Coordinates are SVY21 (EPSG:3414) X/Y and WGS84 lat/long from OneMap.
purpose: Candidate HDB block locations; clipped to the Queenstown planning area by build_queenstown_geography.R.
